payload.title: DIP-L04: Reconcile follow-up intent and prose plans without backlog noise
payload.description:
Protocol boundary. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

Prompt capture is conservative. Semantic refinement, selection of an existing task, splitting future ideas and saving prose-only plans still rely on the current agent's explicit intent calls. Instructions and skills cannot guarantee compliance by every agent.

Evidence and starting points: docs/automation.md, docs/desktop-qa.md, src/automation.js.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: A follow-up refines the existing requirement without leaving an orphaned duplicate actionable request; informational questions do not accumulate as development work.
Save prose and structured plans under both confirmed-hook and fallback paths while keeping future ideas in backlog.
Provide a concise intent transition protocol using the existing agent; add no implicit classifier/model call or per-edit semantic logging.
Test changed requirements, scope/dependencies, interrupted work and truthful verification; agent claims never establish completion.
